title: 2026 Sanlam Cape Town Marathon official route map (JPG)
claims: The map marks a Stadium Start and a Beach Rd Start, and a Finish Line in the Green Point precinct.
The map marks kilometre points at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40 km.
The map prints CUT-OFF 1 at 7 km and 10:30, CUT-OFF 2 at 11 km and 11:05, CUT-OFF 3 at 14 km and 11:30, and CUT-OFF 4 at 20 km and 12:30.
The map prints CUT-OFF 6 at 30.5 km and 14:10, CUT-OFF 7 at 32.6 km and 14:30, CUT-OFF 8 at 36.0 km and 15:00, CUT-OFF 9 at 38.7 km and 15:20, and CUT-OFF 10 at 41.4 km and 15:45.
The map prints CUT-OFF 5 at 25.5 km with a time of 13:20.
The map shows hydration-station, medical and nutrition icons along the route.
The map labels Sea Point, Green Point, the Cape Town city centre, Woodstock, Salt River, Rondebosch Common, Claremont, Newlands, Observatory, Table Mountain, Signal Hill and Lion's Head.
The published route map is a raster image; no GPX, KML or GeoJSON download is offered on the marathon page.
